Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up our CSE455 staff meeting for next week. My free half-hours are:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30

Which one suits you? Once you confirm I'll put it on my calendar.

Hi Professor — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works for me: I have it free before my CSE455 office hours. I've put our CSE455 staff meeting on my calendar for Wednesday 10:00-10:30. Please book the same, and it's then settled on both sides.
Booked: CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 10:00-10:30, on my calendar. It's on both sides now — see you then.
Perfect — both sides booked. See you Wednesday 10:00.
